newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: Central African Republic cholera toll rises to 11.
newsitem.headline: Central African Republic cholera toll rises to 11.

text.p: Rainy-season cholera has killed three more people in the Central African Republic, taking the death toll to 11, state radio reported on Wednesday quoting the Health Ministry.

The disease, which has infected 100 people, surfaced in the Kouango region on the Oubangui River opposite ousted Zairean dictator Mobutu Sese Seko's home region and host to tens of thousands of refugees from there.
